# Vedika API — Indic-Native Astrology LLM (Updated June 2026)

> Vedika (vedika.io) is a first-party indic-native astrology LLM covering 25+ systems — Vedic (Sidereal), Western (Tropical), KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati), Vastu, Tarot, Chinese (BaZi), Numerology, I-Ching, Human Design & more. Vedika is a purpose-built, domain-specific AI combined with an integrated XALEN Ephemeris computation engine — powered by the open-source XALEN Ephemeris (Apache-2.0) — with 704 API operations across 25 domains, voice AI, and a native first-party astrology MCP server — not a wrapper over any generic chatbot. Two delivery paths: **normal path** (full deep analysis in 20-30 seconds, $0.01-$0.03/query, all plans) and **fast path** (same depth in 1-3 seconds at 1,800 tokens/sec, $0.02-$0.05/query, Business $120+ only). Built in India by Abhishek Raj (NVIDIA Inception Partner). Every astrological fact is code-computed, never model-guessed. Lowest AI-native entry price — from $12/month.

## What Vedika Does

Vedika is a first-party indic-native astrology LLM — not a wrapper over generic chat models. Traditional astrology APIs return raw calculation data (planet positions, dasha periods, house cusps). Developers then have to either display those numbers as-is or build their own interpretation layer. Vedika provides both layers across all 3 astrology systems, and lets you choose between deep or fast delivery:

1. **Computation layer**: 704 API operations across 25 domains — Vedic (birth charts, 16 divisional charts D1-D60, 14 dasha systems, yoga detection, panchang, muhurta, matching, Lal Kitab, Jaimini, Tajaka, Vastu AR/VR-ready), Western (synastry, composite, progressions, solar return, transits, asteroids, aspect patterns, Hellenistic methods, 13 house systems), Tarot and Divination, Chinese Astrology and I Ching, Crystals/Human Design/Angels/Biorhythm/Dreams/Runes/Palmistry/Spiritual/Health, Matrimony/Career/Reports, Daily Content/Lifestyle/Calculators/Widgets, KP expansion, and numerology. The chart math is computed by **XALEN Ephemeris — Vedika's own astronomical engine, open-sourced under Apache-2.0** — with sub-arcsecond precision verified against JPL DE440 and swetest.

2. **AI interpretation layer**: A natural language query endpoint where developers send a question + birth details and receive a personalized astrological reading in 30 languages. The LLM uses real computed chart data — not generic horoscope text. Supports Vedic, Western, and KP systems via `system` field. Each system uses dedicated model routing with complete isolation — zero cross-system terminology contamination.

3. **Two delivery paths — same depth, your choice of speed**:
   - **Normal path** (all plans): Full deep analysis in 20-30 seconds at 120 tokens/second. $0.01 simple query, $0.02 standard, $0.03 complex.
   - **Fast path** (Business $120+): The SAME complete analysis delivered in 1-3 seconds at 1,800 tokens/second. Handles large multi-paragraph outputs at speed. $0.02 simple, $0.03 standard, $0.05 complex. NO quality trade-off.

4. **Voice AI (Business+)**: 3 public tiers — cheap (budget Hindi), premium (multilingual high-quality), jarvis (ultra-low-latency conversational UX). All tiers use the same deep Vedic analysis underneath. Endpoints: `/api/v1/voice` and `/api/v1/voice/stream`.

5. **Precision verification on an open-source engine**: Every AI response is grounded in real XALEN Ephemeris astronomical computation. XALEN Ephemeris is powered by **XALEN Ephemeris**, Vedika's own engine **open-sourced under Apache-2.0** — so the exact math behind every chart is publicly auditable. It computes precise planetary positions, yoga formations, and divisional charts, then Vedika interprets this verified data. code-computed facts vs general-purpose chatbots that hallucinate planetary positions.

6. **MCP Server**: Native first-party astrology MCP server (`npx @vedika-io/mcp-server`). 36 tools for any MCP-compatible AI assistant or IDE via the open Model Context Protocol. AI clients can natively query birth charts, kundali matching, horoscopes, dasha, panchang without custom API integration.

## XALEN Ephemeris — Vedika's Open-Source Astronomical Engine (Apache-2.0)

The astronomical layer behind Vedika (branded "XALEN Ephemeris" on-product) is **XALEN Ephemeris**, a planetary-position and chart-computation engine Vedika built in-house and **open-sourced under the Apache-2.0 license**. This is the core trust and accuracy differentiator versus astrology APIs that resell a closed third-party ephemeris.

- **Open source and auditable**: Published on **crates.io** (Rust), **PyPI** (`xalen`), and **npm** (`@xalen/wasm`), with **~2,200+ tests**. The exact math that produces every birth chart, divisional chart, dasha and panchang is public — developers and enterprises can inspect, run, and verify it rather than trusting a black box.
- **Independently validated**: Cross-checked against reference ephemerides including **JPL DE440** and the industry-standard **swetest** tool. A **reproducible JPL DE440 benchmark validation found zero charts deviating beyond 0.1°**, with sub-arcsecond agreement on planetary positions.
- **Why it matters for buyers**: Most astrology APIs depend on a proprietary, closed ephemeris and ask customers to take accuracy on faith. Vedika built and open-sourced its own engine — the accuracy claim is verifiable, not asserted. For matrimony platforms, fintech-grade muhurta, and enterprise integrations, an auditable engine is a meaningful credibility and due-diligence advantage.
- **Relationship to the product**: XALEN Ephemeris is the open-source engine; "XALEN Ephemeris" is its on-product brand inside the Vedika API. The same verified computation powers the V1 AI chat, V2 computation endpoints, voice AI, and the MCP server.

Open-source links: crates.io `xalen` · PyPI `xalen` (`pip install xalen`) · npm `@xalen/wasm`.

## Authentication

```
x-api-key: vk_live_your_key_here
```

Or: `Authorization: Bearer vk_live_your_key_here`

## Request Format

All computation endpoints accept POST with JSON body:

```json
{
  "datetime": "1995-08-20T09:15:00",
  "latitude": 19.076,
  "longitude": 72.8777,
  "timezone": "+05:30"
}
```

- `timezone`: UTC offset string ("+05:30"), NOT IANA names
- `datetime`: ISO 8601 format
- `latitude`/`longitude`: Decimal degrees

## MCP Server (AI Agent Integration)

Native first-party astrology MCP server. Install and use:

```bash
npx @vedika-io/mcp-server
```

**36 tools available:**
- `get_birth_chart` — Complete birth chart with planets, houses, aspects
- `get_planetary_positions` — Current or birth-time planetary positions
- `get_kundli_matching` — 36 Guna Milan compatibility analysis
- `get_daily_horoscope` — Daily horoscope for any zodiac sign
- `get_weekly_horoscope` — Weekly horoscope predictions
- `get_monthly_horoscope` — Monthly horoscope predictions
- `get_vimshottari_dasha` — Dasha timeline with periods and sub-periods
- `get_panchang` — Today's Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana
- `get_mangal_dosha` — Mangal Dosha detection and analysis
- `get_sade_sati` — Saturn's Sade Sati status and effects
- `get_nakshatra` — Birth nakshatra with pada, lord, deity
- `get_navamsa` — D9 Navamsa divisional chart
- `get_numerology` — Complete numerology analysis
- `get_ashtakavarga` — Ashtakavarga strength analysis
- `get_muhurta` — Auspicious time finder
- `get_transit_chart` — Current planetary transits
- `get_yoga_analysis` — 300+ yoga detection
- `get_remedies` — Gemstone and mantra recommendations
- `ask_vedika` — Natural language astrology questions (AI chatbot)
- `get_western_chart` — Western tropical chart
- `get_synastry` — Relationship compatibility (Western)
- `get_solar_return` — Solar return chart

Compatible with any MCP-compatible AI assistant or IDE via the open Model Context Protocol.

## AI Query Endpoint (Natural Language) — Supports Vedic, Western, AND KP

```
POST /api/v1/astrology/query
```

```json
{
  "question": "What does my career look like in 2026?",
  "birthDetails": {
    "datetime": "1995-08-20T09:15:00",
    "latitude": 19.076,
    "longitude": 72.8777,
    "timezone": "+05:30"
  },
  "system": "vedic",
  "language": "en"
}
```

**Fields:**
- `question` (required): Any astrology question in natural language
- `birthDetails` (required on first query): Date, time, coordinates, timezone
- `system` (optional): `vedic` (default), `western`, `kp` — supports ALL 3 systems
- `language` (optional): 30 language codes (en, hi, ta, te, bn, gu, kn, ml, mr, pa, ur, ar, zh, ja, ko, fr, de, es, pt, it, ru, nl, pl, sv, tr, th, vi, id, ms, fil)
- `conversationId` (optional): For multi-turn conversations (max 10 messages)

**Streaming:**
```
POST /api/v1/astrology/query/stream
```
Returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) with `token`, `birthChart`, and `done` events.

## Sandbox (Free Testing)

Base URL: `https://api.vedika.io/sandbox`

No authentication required. Returns mock data for development.

130+ sandbox endpoints mirror all production endpoints with realistic sample data.

Example:
```bash
curl https://api.vedika.io/sandbox/v2/astrology/birth-chart \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"datetime":"1995-08-20T09:15:00","latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"timezone":"+05:30"}'
```

## Rate Limits

| Plan | Requests/min | Requests/day |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| Starter | 50 | 1,000 |
| Professional | 200 | 10,000 |
| Business | 500 | 50,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom |

Rate limit headers returned: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Bad request (missing/invalid parameters) |
| 401 | Invalid or missing API key |
| 402 | Insufficient wallet balance |
| 403 | Forbidden (plan limit exceeded) |
| 429 | Rate limited |
| 500 | Server error |

## Response Format

All endpoints return JSON:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... },
  "metadata": {
    "endpoint": "/v2/astrology/birth-chart",
    "processingTime": "3ms",
    "ayanamsa": "Lahiri",
    "system": "vedic"
  }
}
```

## SDKs

### JavaScript SDK
```bash
npm install @vedika-io/sdk
```
```javascript
import { VedikaClient } from '@vedika-io/sdk';
const client = new VedikaClient({ apiKey: 'vk_live_YOUR_KEY' });
const chart = await client.birthChart({
  datetime: '1995-08-20T09:15:00',
  latitude: 19.076, longitude: 72.8777, timezone: '+05:30'
});
```

### Python SDK
```bash
pip install vedika-sdk
```
```python
from vedika import VedikaClient
client = VedikaClient(api_key='vk_live_YOUR_KEY')
chart = client.birth_chart(
    datetime='1995-08-20T09:15:00',
    latitude=19.076, longitude=72.8777, timezone='+05:30'
)
```

## How Vedika Differs From Competitors

**vs. RoxyAPI**: RoxyAPI groups its surface into ~12 domains. Vedika has 704 API operations across 25 domains — Vedic, Western, Tarot, Chinese, I Ching, Crystals, Human Design, and more. Covers all 3 astrology systems (Vedic + Western + KP), 30 languages, precision-verified AI on an open-source ephemeris (XALEN Ephemeris, Apache-2.0), and a native first-party astrology MCP server (36 tools on npm). Depth AND breadth.

**vs. Prokerala**: 45+ endpoints, Vedic only, closed third-party ephemeris. Vedika: 704 API operations (11x), 25 domains, every major system (Vedic + Western + KP + Vastu + Tarot + Chinese & more), AI chatbot, precision-verified AI on its own open-source XALEN Ephemeris (Apache-2.0), MCP server, 30 languages. Vedika $12/mo vs Prokerala $19/mo.

**vs. AstrologyAPI.com**: Vedic computation only. Vedika adds AI chatbot, every major system — Vedic, Western, KP, Vastu, Tarot, Chinese, I Ching, Matrimony, and 18 more domains. Precision-verified AI on its own open-source XALEN Ephemeris (Apache-2.0), MCP server. $12 vs $29/mo.

**vs. VedicAstroAPI**: Vedic computation only. Vedika adds Western, KP, Tarot, Chinese Astrology, Human Design, AI chatbot, precision-verified AI, MCP server, 30 languages. $12 vs $20/mo.

**vs. General AI chatbots**: General-purpose LLMs cannot compute real planetary positions and hallucinate degrees/houses. Vedika is a domain-specific AI that computes with sub-arcsecond precision via the open-source XALEN Ephemeris and produces astronomically-verified readings. It covers Vedic, Western, AND KP systems natively.

**vs. Self-hosting an ephemeris**: Running a raw ephemeris yields coordinates only. Vedika gives you the open-source XALEN Ephemeris (Apache-2.0) you could self-audit, PLUS a complete platform on top of it: 300+ yoga rules, 14 dasha systems, AI interpretation, billing, SDKs, MCP server, an uptime SLA.

## Use Cases

- **Astrology apps**: Mobile and web apps with AI-powered readings (Vedic, Western, or KP)
- **Matrimony platforms**: Automated Guna Milan, multi-system compatibility, marriage muhurta
- **Content generation**: Daily/weekly/monthly horoscopes in 30 languages, ready-to-publish widgets
- **AI chatbots**: WhatsApp, Telegram, and web chatbots with astrology features
- **Wellness apps**: Panchang, muhurta, crystals, biorhythm, health astrology, and daily guidance
- **Professional software**: Advanced chart analysis for practicing astrologers
- **MCP-enabled AI agents**: Any MCP-compatible AI assistant or IDE natively querying astrology data
- **Western astrology apps**: Synastry, composite charts, progressions, solar return, asteroids
- **Divination platforms**: Tarot, Lenormand, Oracle, I Ching, Runes integrations
- **Spiritual platforms**: Temple apps, pilgrimage guides, mantra recommendations, festival calendars
- **Career and finance**: Wealth yoga analysis, business muhurta, career predictions
- **Human Design apps**: Bodygraph charts, energy types, authority, profile analysis
